Actress Accuses Siblings of Rs 46 Crore Fraud, Files Police Complaint

An actress has filed a police complaint accusing her brother and sister of defrauding her of Rs 46 crore. The complaint details allegations of fraud involving a cheque amounting to ₹46 crore, which has reportedly caused a stir. The actress, identified as Radha, has lodged the FIR against her sister, Ambika, and brother.
